items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: And then in July Bob is doing a mini-tour with Kenny Davern

ctx.x: We need that. Well this has really been fascinating. What’s in the near future for you guys?

Well we leave for England on June the first. We go to Silkeborg in Denmark for a wonderful festival which is — now here’s the thing — sponsored by Tuborg Beer, which money is no object which is lovely so it shows you where their values are. But nonetheless, we’ve been going for three years now. We are going to be there with the Bechet legacy as I say with Phil Flanigan and Eddie Metz, Mark Shane and Dave Cliff, a wonderful guitarist from England that we’ve used a lot, and Eric Jon Kellso, the trumpet player. And…
That’s what I was about to say, my God.
